title: Molecular dynamics of the ERRgamma ligand-binding domain bound with agonist and inverse agonist.
authors: Sasidharan, Santanu; Radhakrishnan, Kamalakannan; Lee, Jun-Yeong; Saudagar, Prakash; Gosu, Vijayakumar; Shin, Donghyun
one_liner_zh: 该文用MD模拟研究ERRgamma配体结合域与激动剂/反向激动剂的动态行为，但对象为核受体-小分子配体互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: Estrogen-related receptor gamma (ERRgamma), the latest member of the ERR family, does not have any known reported natural ligands. Although the crystal structures of the apo, agonist-bound, and inverse agonist-bound ligand-binding domain (LBD) of ERRgamma have been solved previously, their dynamic behavior has not been studied. Hence, to explore the intrinsic dynamics of the apo and ligand-bound forms of ERRgamma, we applied long-range molecular dynamics (MD) simulations to the crystal structures of the apo and ligand-bound forms of the LBD of ERRgamma. Using the MD trajectories, we performed hydrogen bond and binding free energy analysis, which suggested that the agonist displayed more hydrogen bonds with ERRgamma than the inverse agonist 4-OHT. However, the binding energy of 4-OHT was higher than that of the agonist GSK4716, indicating that hydrophobic interactions are crucial for the binding of the inverse agonist. From principal component analysis, we observed that the AF-2 helix conformation at the C-terminal domain was similar to the initial structures during simulations, indicating that the AF-2 helix conformation is crucial with respect to the agonist or inverse agonist for further functional activity of ERRgamma. In addition, we performed residue network analysis to understand intramolecular signal transduction within the protein. The betweenness centrality suggested that few of the amino acids are important for residue signal transduction in apo and ligand-bound forms. The results from this study may assist in designing better therapeutic compounds against ERRgamma associated diseases.
abstract_zh: 雌激素相关受体γ（ERRgamma）是ERR家族的最新成员，目前尚无已知的天然配体报道。尽管ERRgamma的配体结合域（LBD）在无配体（apo）、激动剂结合和反向激动剂结合状态下的晶体结构已被解析，但其动态行为尚未被研究。因此，为了探索ERRgamma无配体及配体结合形式的内在动力学特性，我们对其LBD的无配体和配体结合晶体结构进行了长时间分子动力学（MD）模拟。利用MD轨迹，我们进行了氢键和结合自由能分析，结果表明激动剂与ERRgamma形成的氢键数量多于反向激动剂4-OHT。然而，4-OHT的结合能高于激动剂GSK4716，这表明疏水相互作用对反向激动剂的结合至关重要。通过主成分分析，我们观察到在模拟过程中，C末端结构域的AF-2螺旋构象与初始结构相似，表明AF-2螺旋构象对于ERRgamma在激动剂或反向激动剂作用下的进一步功能活性至关重要。此外，我们进行了残基网络分析，以理解蛋白质内部的分子内信号转导。介数中心性分析表明，在无配体和配体结合形式中，少数氨基酸对残基信号转导具有重要作用。本研究的结果可能有助于设计针对ERRgamma相关疾病的更优治疗化合物。
